scope_summary: PR #42 adds an optional 'status' query filter to GET /v1/orders and a required 'reason' field to POST /v1/orders/{orderId}/cancel. Tests cover the new filter, validation of the new field, tenant isolation on the changed endpoints, and regression of unfiltered listing.
assumptions: Fixture order ord_fixture_open_001 exists for tenant A in status 'open' and may be cancelled in the staging environment.
Allowed status values are taken from the OpenAPI enum OrderStatus: open, paid, shipped, cancelled.
out_of_scope: Performance and load characteristics of the listing endpoint.
Database migration correctness (not observable through the API).

test_cases.title: List orders filtered by status=open
test_cases.purpose: Verify the new status filter returns only orders in the requested status.
test_cases.notes: Schema v1.0 has no wildcard JSONPath, so per-item status checks are not expressible here; TC-002 checks the first item deterministically.

test_cases.title: Filtered list first item has requested status
test_cases.purpose: Deterministically check that the first returned order matches the filter value.

test_cases.title: Reject unknown status filter value
test_cases.purpose: Verify invalid enum values for the new filter are rejected with a validation error instead of being ignored.

test_cases.title: Unfiltered listing still works (regression)
test_cases.purpose: Verify existing clients that do not send the status filter still receive a valid list.

test_cases.title: Listing without credentials is rejected
test_cases.purpose: Verify the changed listing endpoint still requires authentication.

test_cases.title: Cancel order without reason is rejected
test_cases.purpose: Verify the new required 'reason' field is enforced on cancellation.

test_cases.title: Tenant B cannot cancel tenant A order
test_cases.purpose: Verify tenant isolation on the changed cancellation endpoint; a foreign tenant must not learn about or modify the order.

test_cases.title: Reason longer than documented maximum is rejected
test_cases.purpose: Verify the documented maxLength (500) of 'reason' is enforced at the boundary + 1.
